title: People before roles
sub: The opening film of People first, in Leading data people: a team is people before it is roles. Before you plan anyone's work from a chart or a list, sit down with each person, notice who the others turn to, and say early what won't change yet.
howto: The film is drawn in the module's sunlit plaster: a gorge in the Andes and the team's rooms, in daylight, with sheets pinned to the wall. Its colours mean the same in every film: blue is plans (the chart of seven boxes), orange is data (the list of requests), green is something done or kept, and amber a risk or something waiting. People and their clothes wear none of them.
